title: TECNO Mobile’s CAMON Slim 5G: Making life lighter, one moment of becoming at a time

blocks.text: Life takes different paths for different people. For young working Filipinas balancing careers, personal ambitions, relationships, and everyday responsibilities, finding ways to make each day a little easier can begin with something as simple as reaching out to loved ones, leaning on a community, or discovering practical tools that help lighten the load.

This idea takes center stage in 100 Portraits of Becoming, a portrait series by renowned Brazilian photographer Angélica Dass that celebrates the experiences of Filipino solo mothers, their personal journeys, and the networks of support that help them navigate everyday life. The project also reflects the thinking behind the TECNO CAMON SLIM 5G and its tagline, “Make It Lighter,” exploring how the right support (whether from people, communities, the government, or technology) can help make everyday life more manageable. Through their portraits and stories, the project offers a reminder that while every journey is unique, the people, resources, and practical tools that support us along the way also matter and help lighten the load.

At the heart of these portraits’ stories is diskarte, the resourcefulness Filipinos draw on to find solutions, make things work, and move forward on their own terms. It can be found in the everyday decisions people make, the relationships they nurture, and the support they give and receive. For some, making life lighter means having family members or trusted friends to turn to. For others, it may mean finding a community that understands their circumstances or using practical tools that help them manage their daily routines. What matters is recognizing the resources available to us and finding ways to make them work for our individual needs.

The stories in 100 Portraits of Becoming invite audiences to reflect on their own support systems, not by assuming that everyone faces the same circumstances, but by recognizing the value of connection, resourcefulness, and shared care in different stages of life. For young working Filipinas, this reflection can be particularly meaningful. Between professional commitments, personal goals, and the demands of daily living, the little things that make a task simpler or help us stay connected can make a difference.

Making life lighter does not mean having everything figured out or handling every responsibility alone. It can also mean knowing when to ask for help, appreciating the people who show up for us, and choosing tools that fit our needs.
Technology that helps make everyday life lighter

This is where thoughtful technology, like the TECNO CAMON SLIM 5G, can become part of the conversation, bringing this idea to life through features designed to support everyday activities. Guided by the tagline “Make It Lighter,” the smartphone offers practical functionality in a slim design, giving users a device they can rely on as they move through their daily routines.

Measuring just 6.39mm thin, the CAMON SLIM 5G packs a 6,000mAh battery designed for long-lasting use. Its combination of portability and battery capacity offers a practical companion for people who spend their days moving between work, errands, and personal commitments. For capturing the moments that matter, the phone features a 50MP Sony LYTIA 700C camera with Super-Zoom FlashSnap and Universal Tone. Whether documenting a personal milestone, preserving everyday
memories, or sharing moments with loved ones, its imaging features help users capture and share their experiences.

The device is also built to handle different environments as it comes with IP69K, IP69, and IP68 dust and water resistance ratings, along with Rain Touch technology. Its 1.5K 144Hz ultra-bright AMOLED display delivers a vivid viewing experience, while the TECNO MagBadge lets users mirror the moment and express their personal style. Available in Burgundy Red, Gossamer White, Matisse Black, and Rebel Pink, the CAMON SLIM 5G comes in a 256GB ROM configuration with 24GB RAM (8GB physical RAM plus 16GB extended RAM).

It is also worth noting that these features are not a substitute for the people and relationships that sustain us. Rather, they illustrate how technology can complement the ways people already navigate their lives, helping with communication, capturing memories, and managing everyday activities.
Every journey has its own kind of support

The stories behind 100 Portraits of Becoming are a celebration of individual journeys and the people who help make them possible. They also offer a broader invitation, to look at our own lives and recognize the people, communities, and everyday solutions that help us move forward. Sometimes, making life lighter means accepting support, while it can also mean finding a more practical way to accomplish a task. However, it likewise means extending that same understanding and consideration to someone else.

Ultimately, diskarte belongs to the people who practice it; it reflects their choices, ingenuity, circumstances, and relationships. Technology can certainly play a supporting role, but it is the people themselves who give these everyday acts their meaning.

With this, the 100 Portraits of Becoming and the TECNO CAMON SLIM 5G have made the message simple: no two journeys are exactly alike, and there is no single way to make life lighter. What matters is recognizing what helps us along the way and remembering that the right support (whether from a person, a community, or even a smartphone) can make a meaningful difference.
